secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Neon PostgreSQL connection string (postgresql://...?sslmode=require). From Neon dashboard → Connection Details.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing secret for auth tokens (min 32 chars). Internal app secret, not an external credential.

secrets.name: CSRF_SECRET
secrets.description: CSRF double-submit cookie signing secret (min 16 chars). Internal app secret, not an external credential.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Admin login password for admin@prince-net.local (min 12 chars). Internal, not an external credential.
